info.title: Insight Pre-Trade Safety API
info.description: Oracle-immune-system pre-trade safety checks with verifiable EIP-712 attestation support. One GET returns a verdict (PASS / ALERT / BLOCK) for a single trade, priced per call in USDC via x402 on Base mainnet. BLOCK verdicts are complete checks and are charged. Also exposes the full oracle tool catalog over MCP (JSON-RPC 2.0 streamable HTTP) with x402 pay-per-call.
info.x-guidance: REST: call GET /api/v1/safety/pre-trade with query parameters: asset (e.g. ETH), chainId (e.g. 1), action (swap|borrow|lend|liquidate|repay), tradeAmountUsd. MCP: POST /api/mcp with JSON-RPC 2.0, method=tools/call and params.name set to a tool name (e.g. get_symbols, pre_trade_safety_check, get_risk_summary). Unauthenticated requests receive HTTP 402 with an x402 v2 payment challenge (USDC on Base, eip155:8453); retry the same request with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header to receive the result. Every paid response carries a verifiable EIP-712 receipt (keyless verification at oracleinsight.xyz/verify). REST: add schemaVersion=2 or 3 to include quorum-gate and independence-threshold attestation fields.

get.summary: Pre-trade safety check with verifiable attestation

parameters.name: asset
parameters.description: Asset symbol, e.g. ETH, BTC, USDC

parameters.name: targetProviders
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of oracle providers to restrict the check to

parameters.name: protocolId
parameters.description: Optional lending protocol id to evaluate against

parameters.name: schemaVersion
parameters.description: Attestation schema version: 1 (default, 11-field), 2 (26-field, CAIP-19 + quorum gate), 3 (27-field: v2 + signed independence threshold)

parameters.name: destinationAsset
parameters.description: Optional destination asset symbol (v2 binds it as destinationAssetId)

200.description: Safety verdict returned (request was paid via x402 or authorized by API key)

401.description: Unauthorized (paid tier disarmed and no API key supplied)

402.description: Payment Required: x402 v2 challenge in the payment-required response header (base64 JSON with accepts[].amount in USDC atomic units on Base eip155:8453 and bazaar discovery metadata).

post.summary: MCP tools/call over JSON-RPC 2.0 (streamable HTTP), x402 pay-per-call
post.description: Pay-per-call access to the Insight oracle tool catalog (40+ tools: prices, consensus, peg risk, lending safety) for x402 agents without an API key. Price scales with the tool metering class (C1=$0.002, C2=$0.008, C3=$0.02, C4=$0.04). tools/list and initialize are free. Every paid response carries a verifiable EIP-712 attestation receipt.

200.description: JSON-RPC response (paid via x402 or free method); paid tools/call responses include the EIP-712 attestation receipt in the tool result content

402.description: Payment Required: x402 v2 challenge in the payment-required response header (base64 JSON with accepts[].amount in USDC atomic units on Base eip155:8453 and bazaar discovery metadata). Amount in the challenge reflects the requested tool's metering class.
